description: Amazon Associates Creators API reads. This is an official credentialed product API and requires approved Creators API credentials plus a marketplace PartnerTag; it is distinct from anonymous Amazon storefront XHR and legacy PA-API 5 signing.

capabilities.title: Acquire and cache an LwA Creators API bearer token in process memory
capabilities.blocker: The client contract is implemented, but no approved Creators API Credential ID/Secret/version was supplied to this execution for an authenticated token exchange.

capabilities.title: Search Amazon catalog products with bounded page and result limits
capabilities.blocker: No live SearchItems request was sent because registered Creators API credentials and a valid caller-owned PartnerTag were not supplied.
capabilities.note: If Amazon returns items with response-level errors, the adapter retains the items and sanitized error codes, sets partial=true, and sets expectedResultVerified=false.

capabilities.title: Read up to ten ASIN product records and bind each result to requested IDs
capabilities.blocker: No live GetItems request was sent because registered Creators API credentials and a valid caller-owned PartnerTag were not supplied.

capabilities.title: Collect current offer price, currency, reference-price basis, and availability separately
capabilities.blocker: Offer parsing has local contract tests, but Amazon returned no live offer data in this execution. OffersV2 documents featured offers only; it does not provide legacy Offers.Summaries or all seller listings.

capabilities.title: Read sequential SearchItems pages within the documented ten-page and ten-item limits
capabilities.blocker: Pagination boundaries and sequential execution have local contract tests; no authenticated pagination run was available.

capabilities.title: Enumerate marketplace categories and their BrowseNode hierarchy
capabilities.blocker: SearchIndex can be passed when known, but GetBrowseNodes enumeration and its response contract are outside this implementation.

capabilities.title: Use the caller-supplied marketplace PartnerTag in Creators API links
capabilities.blocker: PartnerTag is caller-supplied and is never invented. No Amazon marketplace PartnerTag was supplied to this execution.

capabilities.title: Modify a retail cart, purchase, order, or delivery address
capabilities.applicabilityReason: This implementation is limited to read-only Associates product and offer data; retail cart and order changes were not requested.
